lines.text: Moses says to appoint judges and officials in every town, who must not accept a bribe, which blinds the eyes of the wise.
Moses forbids a wooden Asherah pole beside the altar and a sacred pillar, and forbids sacrificing a flawed ox or sheep.
If a report of worshiping other gods is true, the person is stoned at the town gates on the word of one witness.

wrong_details.wrong: on the word of one witness
wrong_details.true: on the testimony of two or three witnesses

lines.text: For a case too difficult to judge, people go to the Levitical priests and the judge at the place the LORD will choose.
The king chosen by the LORD must be an Israelite, must not take many wives, and must write a copy of the instruction and read it for his first year.

wrong_details.wrong: read it for his first year
wrong_details.true: read from it all the days of his life
